title: Highest Cumulative Score
body:
Score entries name score arrive one at a time and add up per person. At the end, find the person with the highest total. If several people share the highest total, the winner is the one who first reached at least that total while the entries were arriving.

Function to complete

Complete winner(names, scores). It returns the winner's name.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.

samples.ex: Both end on 5, but andrew got there on the 2nd entry and mike on the 3rd.

samples.in:
6
A 3
B 2
A 5
B 6
A 1
B 1
